stemMd: Two adult tickets and three child tickets cost 31 units. One adult ticket and one child ticket cost 13 units. What is the child-ticket price?
explanationMd: Double the second relation to obtain two adults plus two children for 26. Subtract this from 31 to get one child at 5; the adult price is then 8. Both totals check.

distractorRationale.a: This subtracts the totals without accounting for ticket counts.
distractorRationale.b: This is a ticket count, not the solved price.
distractorRationale.c: This is the combined price of one of each.
